ValidationRule.description: If Status is "Relieved" and Relieving Date > Resignation Date or Today.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c,"Relieved") , OR( ISBLANK( Relieving_Date__c ), Relieving_Date__c > Date_of_Resignation__c , Relieving_Date__c > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Relieving Date > Resignation Date or Today.
